avis.texte: I’ve been using The Ordinary Glucoside Foaming Cleanser for a while now, and I’m really impressed with how gentle yet effective it is. It creates a light foam that cleans my skin without leaving it feeling dry or tight, which is something I struggle with when using other cleansers. I love that it removes dirt, oil, and even light makeup easily while still being suitable for sensitive skin. The formula feels very clean and simple, and it doesn’t have a strong fragrance, which is a big plus for me. After using it consistently, my skin feels softer, more balanced, and less irritated. It’s also very affordable for the quality you get, which makes it even better. Overall, this is a great everyday cleanser, especially if you’re looking for something gentle but effective. I would definitely recommend it!

avis.titre: Gentle cleanser that doesn’t leave my skin tightGentle cleanser that doesn’t leave my skin tight
avis.texte: I’ve been using this The Ordinary Glucoside Foaming Cleanser in the evening and sometimes in the morning too. I wanted something simple that cleans well without making my skin feel stripped, and this one does a good job. It foams lightly, rinses easily, and my face feels clean but still comfortable afterward. I also like that it has no strong fragrance. A little goes a pretty long way. The only small downside for me is that the foam is pretty light, so if you wear heavy makeup you may need a second cleanse. But for everyday use, it’s been really nice and gentle on my skin.

avis.titre: Gentle Cleanser That Removes Makeup Well
avis.texte: I’ve been really happy with this cleansing wash overall. The formula feels lightweight and gentle on my skin while still doing a great job removing makeup, sunscreen, and everyday buildup without leaving my face feeling stripped or overly dry afterward. One thing I noticed right away was how soft and clean my skin felt after using it. It foams nicely without being too harsh, and a little product goes a long way. I also appreciated that it rinses off easily and doesn’t leave behind any greasy or tight feeling. I’ve used this both as a regular daily cleanser and for removing makeup, and it handled both really well. Even after continued use, my skin still felt balanced and comfortable, which can be hard to find with foaming cleansers sometimes. The packaging is also simple and easy to use. Overall, this is a gentle, effective cleanser that works especially well for everyday use and makeup removal. I’d definitely recommend it if you’re looking for something that cleans thoroughly while still feeling lightweight and non-irritating on the skin.

avis.titre: Overall holy grail for sensitive skin. Super affordable + high quality!!
avis.texte: Excellent value for the size! You don’t need a lot of product to get a good lather going. The foam is a nice texture and very gentle on sensitive skin. I was experiencing seb derm when I switched to it and helped calm it down tremendously just after a few days. I pair it with their Beta Glucan Moisturizer and they have become my new holy grail. Both give the perfect amount of moisture without over drying or leaving my face greasy. My t-zone used to be very oily but now my skin overall has a healthy matte, plump look to it. I really love the affordability and quality of this product as well.

I really like this cleanser! I have always struggled with skin sensitivity and this product hasn’t caused any irritation. The ingredients are very gentle, clean, and there’s also no-fragrance. Anyone who struggles with sensitive skin knows that fragrance is a big no. It foams up very nicely, leaving my skin very refreshed and moisturized.

avis.titre: Repeat buy: unscented, gentle foam, clean skin without the tight-face drama  ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5 stars
avis.texte: Quick answers: Unscented? Yes Foams well? Yes, just enough Leaves skin tight/dry? No Good value? Excellent Bottle easy to use? Yes Would buy again? Already have, several times I’ve bought this cleanser several times because it does exactly what I want a daily face wash to do: clean my skin without turning my face into a raisin. It’s unscented, gentle, and has the perfect amount of foam. Not a bubble party, not sad lotion water, just enough lather to feel like it’s actually cleaning. It rinses clean, removes the day, and leaves my skin feeling fresh but not tight or stripped. The bottle is also surprisingly nice to use. It feels good in the hand, the shape is practical, and the lid closes securely so the product stays fresh and doesn’t become bathroom-counter goo. For the price, this is an excellent cleanser. No fragrance drama, no overcomplicated spa ritual, no “why is my skin mad now?” mystery. Just a really solid, gentle face wash that earns its spot on the sink. Would I buy again? Yes. Clearly. Repeatedly.

I’ve been using this cleanser for a about a week now and really like it. It creates a soft foam that cleans my skin well without leaving it feeling dry or tight. My face feels fresh and comfortable after every wash. A great gentle cleanser for everyday use.

Swear this works! So wish I took before and after! I have paired this with Matrixyl, argeline facial moisturizer ,and Retinol products also from Ordinary! I seen results within 1 week! 3 weeks in was noticeable to others! I will be ordering and using more Ordinary products! Wish I would have taken before and after pics but I never thought to do so. It’s a gentle foaming wash. Feels nice! No irritation whatsoever noted from using these products! Good value for the money! Nice amount of product for the price!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Der Glucoside Foaming Cleanser von The Ordinary ist ein sehr angenehmer, milder Gesichtsreiniger. Er entfernt Schmutz, überschüssiges Öl und leichtes Make-up gründlich, ohne die Haut auszutrocknen oder zu spannen. Der Schaum ist fein und lässt sich leicht abspülen. Meine Haut fühlt sich nach der Reinigung sauber, weich und ausgeglichen an. Besonders für empfindliche Haut finde ich ihn sehr gut geeignet. Ich bin sehr zufrieden und werde ihn wieder kaufen.

avis.titre: Ottimo ma per pelli sensibili nì
avis.texte: Pensavo più delicato, ma forse non ho prestato la dovuta attenzione quando ne ho letto le caratteristiche. È di ottima qualità, assolutamente, non aggressivo e pulisce bene. Per pelli delicate o in fase di sensibilizzazione, come era il mio caso, risulta però un pelino forte. Per pelli normali invece è buono. Buona alternativa ai detergenti con acido salicilico ove questo fosse troppo aggressivo.

This is such a good go-to cleanser, great for oily skin and is not too drying. Has basically no scent, foams up nicely, and I find it does a pretty good job of removing makeup too. It's basic, simple, affordable, and all you could ask for in a cleanser. Mayyybe wouldn't recommend for those with dry skin as it doesn't really leave a "hydrating" effect after using.

I have had fungal/hormonal, acne my whole life. I have tried every product under the sun and worked. I am on a low income budget and don’t have money for a dermatologist so I asked ChatGPT designed me a facial routine that could help with my acne and red spots. Chat recommended The Ordinary’s line of products, and I have been thrilled with the results. I love The Ordinary brand in general, and this foaming cleanser is very gentle, while at the same time being great for my acne-prone skin and occasional bumps and redness. I follow the cleanser up with either The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% in the morning and The Ordinary Salicylic Acid 2% Solution at night, and then finish with The Ordinary Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA and sunscreen. My skin has never been better. I have had acne my whole life up till my current age of 35. Nothing has worked except for Head and Shoulder shampoo face masks, which I have continued, along with The Ordinary’s products. Not only do I rarely have acne, but when I do, it disappears quickly and my skin is also glowing and smoother and younger looking! My pores look less large and my skin is so soft. Highly recommend, especially for people with fungal/hormonal acne and sensitive skin. Here is a before and after picture!

First the bad...the gel is runny, not thick, so it can slide off your fingers fast. And that's it. That's the only bad I found which wasn't enough for me not to give it 5 stars. It's gentle, nice "fragrance free" scent, with a nice light lather that deep cleans without overdrying your face. No irritation. Definitely seems like it's good for all skin types. But the best part: The 5.1 ounce tube for significantly less money than other brands makes this one special! For the price it's definitely worth a try.

This is a very simple face wash but I have to say that it does do the job for me which is cleaning my face without over drying. I have sensitive and dry skin so I go for products that are unscented and gentle and this was a great match I wont say its as good as foaming cleansers that I have used in the past, and another comparable product is the anua cleanser very similar to this one. Having finished the bottle already I will likely purchase again in the future but use it on heavy makeup days since I don't really need something this heavy all the time. Other than that I have no complaints.

Seriously, this stuff works wonders! I was so impressed with how affordable it is, especially since it's so effective. My skin feels great, and I didn't experience any irritation at all, which is a huge plus for me. I'm definitely planning on repurchasing this product. It's a total winner in my book!

Oh my goodness, if you ladies and gentlemen haven't heard about this yet, I advise all of you to try these skin care products right away. I saw a video of Nikki Glasser showing how she does her skin care and she was using The Ordinary. I got a starter kit right away and my 82yr old skin has never looked this healthy!!

I've been a hard core CeraVe user for a few years now and I didn't know what I was missing until I used this cleanser. While the CeraVe foaming cleanser would leave my skin feeling tight and stripped of everything The Ordinary does the exact opposite. My skin feels clean while soft and no tight from being stripped of everything. I've only been using it for a couple days and am already in love. I purchased it to go along with all the other serums and moisturizers I purchased from this brand to refresh my skin care routine. I have combination skin with a super oily T-zone so we will see how it works long term.

avis.titre: Su fragancia es agradable, y no marca tu piel
avis.texte: Lo empecé a usar día y noche , y noté cambios a la semana, ayuda con el nivel de grasa en tu piel, la hidratación y las marcas de acné ya sea leve o fuerte , lo amo ayudo con mis inseguridades
I have naturally red skin, but even I can feel when this product burned my skin. It unfortunately did more damage than good for me.

I’ve seen everyone talking about The ordinary cleanser and decided to give it a try and yes it didn’t disappoint at all… it’s very gentle on the skin, no strong smell so you know it’s not filled with harsh fragrances to damage the skin.
This cleanser is mild and leaves your face clean and fresh, I also bought the toner, niacinamide drops and moisturizer it’s done wonders. I highly recommend it.
Make your face feel smooth and super clean after wash. Skin feels radiant. It doesn’t smell bad.Good to add into any facial cleansing routine. Size 5.1 FL.
Helped me clear up a lot of my acne, doesn’t really dry out my skin and gives me a nice glow when i use it.
Recommended, excellent product to eliminate acne and cleanse your face. I wouldn't change it for anything, thanks to Amazon.
Me encanta este producto no es grasoso y es muy ligero al contacto con la piel … lo uso diariamente cada vez que tengo oportunidad de lavarme el rostro .. deja mi piel muy limpia …

avis.titre: You get what you pay for!
avis.texte: After doing some research for affordable clean skincare I ordered five of Ordinary products. Ever heard of the phrase “you get what you pay for”? Well, it’s exactly that with these products. The smell of the foaming cleanser smells medicinal, the moisturizer is pasty, and the peeling solution does not work. And the eye serum? Does nothing for puffy eyelids. The best part is though, I’ve broken out in the most painful white head zits of my entire life. I’m 48 and have never broken out this much. I’m extremely disappointed. Wish I had only purchased one product at a time. Now I’m stuck with this crap I’m not going to use.
I would say it works it keeps my face from getting more spots and bumps been using over a month and my face still haven’t cleared and have a smoooth look

avis.titre: No es malo pero no lo volvería a comprar
avis.texte: Su textura es casi agua, limpia muy bien pero en mi caso a pesar de tener piel grasa, me reseca mucho sobre todo a los lados de la boca
Great skin product however my product was completely destroyed when I opened my package. The liquid oozed out of the box and the tube contained a hole.
I’ve bought this multiple times and it’s great. It doesn’t irritate my skin or my eyes. Good value for money for the size. It doesn’t foam too much but just enough
I love this product, it leaves my skin super soft and clean with just one wash, it removes all the makeup, I'm going for my second order

avis.titre: This brand IS my skin care routine!!!
avis.texte: I started using this brand about a month ago, I got the little travel size with face cleanser, hyaluronic acid, and moisturizer and I can’t remember a time when my skin has looked this good! I’m in my late 30’s and my skin is GLOWING! Definitely worth purchasing the full size products as they last so long. I can’t say enough good things about this brand!!! I even took a no makeup pic to share how great it makes my skin look.
So far so good! Loving this cleanser for my almost 50 year old skin!
